summary: Strong discovery-led call that uncovered real operational and financial pain (missed escalations, turnover, referral acuity, billing leakage) before introducing product value tied directly to those levers. Proof points align closely with published stats, though a couple of stats (30-40% time reclaim) lack sourcing, and objection-handling wasn't tested since no pushback occurred. Ended with a firm, dated next step involving the right stakeholders.
